topic.name: Combining Graph Transformations of Reciprocal Functions

question.text: Which of the following is the graph of $y = -\dfrac{1}{3x}?$
question.explanation:
To plot $y = -\dfrac{1}{3x},$ we apply the following steps:

  • Take the curve $y=-\dfrac{1}{x}.$
  • Stretch the result by a scale factor of $\dfrac{1}{3}$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=-\dfrac{1}{3x}.$

question.text: Which of the following is the graph of $y = -\dfrac{2}{x-2}?$
question.explanation:
To plot $y = -\dfrac{2}{x-2},$ we apply the following steps:

  • Take the curve $y=-\dfrac{1}{x}.$
  • Translate it by $2$ units to the right to get the graph of $y=-\dfrac{1}{x-2}.$
  • Then, stretch the result by a scale factor of $2$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=-\dfrac{2}{x-2}.$
